_note: Every word shown in the video. To make another language, copy this file (ru.json, uz.json), translate the values and render with --lang. UI strings match the app's Localizable.xcstrings and the server's coach templates (backend/src/services/coach.service.js), so take the translations from there.

captions.hook:
Most habit apps
have never seen
your calendar.
captions.voice: A coach that talks your way.

end.sub: The coach that knows your calendar.

today.title: Today
today.moveText: You're busy until 12:30 PM. Want Gym at 12:30 PM instead?
today.nextUpText: Next up: Gym at 12:30 PM. You're free until 2:30 PM.

notification._note: The four reminders follow the voice samples the app shows when you pick a coach (CoachVoice.sample in ios/Habitnex/Models/Profile.swift), fitted to this day: 12:30 PM, Gym, 45 minutes, free until 2:30 PM.
notification.title: Gym
notification.friendly: Meetings are done, Alex! Gym time: just 45 minutes. You've got this!
notification.strict: It's 12:30 PM, Alex. You committed to 45 minutes at the gym. Follow through.
notification.sarcastic: Free until 2:30 PM, Alex. 45 minutes. Those weights won't lift themselves.
notification.calm: Gym starts now: 45 minutes, then you're free until 2:30 PM.

punch._note: The few words of each reminder that carry its tone. They are shown large beside the card, and must appear in the reminder exactly as written here.

later.adaptText: Gym got snoozed 3 times this week. Want to make it easier?

adapt.title: Gym keeps getting pushed back.
adapt.loading: Your coach is looking at your week…
options: You usually start about 30 min late, so plan for when you actually go.
Wednesday worked 1 of 4 times. Fewer, reliable days beat a plan you miss.
Still a real session, and easier to start. Go back to 45 once it sticks.
adapt.changeBack: You can change it back anytime.
keep: 45 min at 12:00. I'll stop suggesting for now.

progress.title: Progress
progress.reviewSub: Story recap with your coach's verdict

voiceover._note: What the narrator says, in order. It is recorded as one continuous take (so it sounds like one person talking, not a row of clips) and then cut into these lines, which the film places on the picture. The four coach names are said as their cards appear.
narration: Most habit apps have never seen your calendar.

chat._note: The Coach tab. The four suggestions marked ✨ and the coach's reply are written by the AI in the app, so these are examples of what it says; the other starters, the suggestion card and its buttons are the app's own.
chat.title: Coach
chat.intro: Hey Alex! I can see your habits and how they're going. Ask me anything, or tell me what's getting in the way.
chat.reply: Feel better, Alex. Want me to pause Gym until Sunday? Paused days don't count against you.
personal: Why do I keep snoozing Gym?
Is noon the right time for Gym?
